title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Late Return Uplift on Engine Overtime
content:
A late return raises the engine overtime charge on metered Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment.

**Rule.** A late return raises the charge: equipment returned two or more calendar days after the due-back date has the charge multiplied by 1.5; equipment returned on the calendar day right after the due-back date has it multiplied by 1.25; equipment returned on or before the due-back date keeps it unchanged.

The multiplier acts on the overtime hours multiplied by the overtime hourly price, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

The return date and the due-back date are the date parts of the return time and the due-back time on the agreement.

## Multiplier table

| Return date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| on or before the due-back date | 1 (unchanged) |
| the calendar day right after the due-back date | 1.25 |
| two or more calendar days after the due-back date | 1.5 |

## Hypothetical figures (overtime hours 6, hourly price 37.50, so 225.00 before the multiplier)

| Due-back | Returned | Multiplier | Figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 July 18:00 | 9 July 22:45 | 1 | 225.00 |
| 9 July 18:00 | 10 July 07:30 | 1.25 | 281.25 |
| 9 July 18:00 | 11 July 09:00 | 1.5 | 337.50 |
